scope: Generated applied playbooks that validate parseable structured input before semantic/content validation.
requirements: Syntax/parse validation must be represented as deterministic helper evidence followed by a mechanical deterministic gate.
Semantic/content validation must not be reachable from the parse gate fail branch.
Parse failure must terminate validation with only parse/syntax findings from machine evidence.
Parse success may continue to structural, fallback, language, placeholder or other semantic validation.
A final all-stage validator must not be used to infer semantic findings after parse failure.

ordo_grounding.control: mechanical deterministic gate using condition and explicit on_pass/on_fail
